session_handoff.bug_partition_pruning_status: FIXED (2026-08-20): Gemini would sometimes query posts_yXXXX child partitions directly by name instead of the parent posts+creationdate filter. This caused a genuinely wrong count:0 answer while posts partitioning was mid-flight (empty child partition existed alongside the real, populated posts). Confirmed via a cross-year test question that multi-year queries already safely used the parent+filter form, but single-year queries were still at risk. Fixed with a new SYSTEM_PROMPT rule (always query posts with a creationdate filter, never posts_yXXXX directly); rebuilt the Docker backend image and verified live.
